messages:
alex: Heads-up everyone — I'm going to run a tf apply for release/2.4.0 in ~15m. Targets: networking (route53/NAT), IAM (service-account rotation). Provider pinned to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v3.45.0. Canary will be staging-only first. Deploybot preflight will run. @oncall please watch. Link to plan: https://tiny.red/plan-1768809991
maria: Thanks — can you paste the plan summary here? Any statefile imports or manual steps? :eyes:
alex: Plan summary: ~3 resources to change, 1 create (nat-gw), 2 update (route table, iam binding). No statefile import needed. Commands I'm using:
```
terraform plan -out=tfplan.release-2.4.0
terraform apply "tfplan.release-2.4.0"
```
Also pinning provider in root module for reproducibility.
jordan: Rollback criteria suggestion: if canary shows >1% 5xx or >20% p95 latency increase sustained for 5m, we revert the merge and reapply previous state. Who will execute rollback?
sam: I'll own rollback exec. If triggered I'll revert the merge (git revert <sha>) and trigger deploybot to reapply previous tf state. Keep me looped.
ops-bot: Change window approved: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Quiet mode enabled for infra channels.
deploy-bot: preflight started: running terraform fmt, validate, provider pin check, and drift-detection
deploy-bot: preflight passed — no unexpected drift, provider pinned to v3.45.0
alex: Starting staging canary now. Tagging canary=true and limiting traffic to 10% where possible.
deploy-bot: apply started on staging (canary) — terraform apply in progress
maria: Watching metrics: http://grafana.company/internal/app - will report anomalies
maria: So far so good, no appreciable errors
sam: Observability alert — 5xx rate increased to 1.2% over baseline at T+3m, correlated with NAT changes
alex: Halting rollout, cancelling any pending prod apply. @jordan please run rollback plan now.
jordan: ACK. Rollback steps I'm running:
```
git revert --no-edit 5f3a2c
terraform apply -var-file=prev-state.tfvars
```
jordan: Revert pushed, deploybot triggered rollback reapply to previous state
deploy-bot: rollback apply started on staging (revert commit 5f3a2c)
deploy-bot: rollback apply completed — staging returned to previous state without errors
maria: Canary metrics back to baseline, no residual errors observed
sam: Keeping prod promotion on hold until a short post-mortem and a smaller incremental change plan
alex: Thanks all. I'll open a short postmortem and add notes to the release docs about the canary regression and mitigations. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Re-opening change window requires a new approval — tag me when you're ready to re-request
sam: Action item filed: add a canary traffic cap + preflight e2e for outbound NAT paths (issue #1245)
alex: Noted, closing thread for now.
